## Identity
Roman Amangeldiyev is an AI product builder, startup founder, Growth Specialist at Car Studio AI, and Computer Engineering student at Bahçeşehir University in Istanbul, Türkiye.

Preferred entity name: Roman Amangeldiyev
Official X / Twitter username: @romangeldiyev

## Selected projects
### hukukcy.com
Canonical case study: https://romanamangeldiyev.com/project-hukukcy.html
Public product: https://hukukcy.com
A Turkmenistan-focused legal AI platform with grounded legal research, formal document workflows, public law access, and document verification.

### Jev AI Experiment
Canonical case study: https://romanamangeldiyev.com/project-jev-ai.html
A 25-profile product experiment testing structured decision-model behavior without a local matching engine, local scoring, or fallback layer.

### PlatoMind
Canonical case study: https://romanamangeldiyev.com/project-platomind.html
An education product experiment designed around structured discussion between multiple stakeholder roles.
